name: BYOC delivery acceleration P-009 combined acceptance matrix
summary: The current-build failure-control cohort, trusted-reuse benchmark and matched short-form loop-wake comparison pass. The production wake shrank from 7,328 to 3,632 characters (50.44%), clearing R-004's literal 50% bar by 32 characters. R-006 remains pending on the canonical BYOC cloud-workspaces deployed journey and literal 24-hour soak; no parallel or synthetic receipt chain is accepted.

currentBuildCohort.head: 2020dffa7c01fafa93c6e5365cdee28c82c45409
currentBuildCohort.provenance: testing:run-status durable snapshot; all 13 named paths clean at pre/post run

R-002.assertion: The maintained current-build release journal, publisher, real-Postgres receipt, identity/preflight and carry suites pass. The named tests exercise deterministic interruption, response loss after acceptance, reconciliation before retry, immutable identity, one-use request IDs and fail-closed disagreement.

R-003.assertion: The current cohort passes the release/control-plane contracts. The latest dedicated live summary cohort remains 40/40 valid with p95 24.898 ms against the 2 s bar, and the locked proxy suite proves unrelated-write admission, same-item conflict handling and unambiguous forwarding outcomes.

R-004.assertion: Warm/cold carry correctness remains covered by the maintained current-build tests. A matched short-form production wake from the same owner and routine, after the stable-id verified-history compactor was active, clears the required byte target without compacting unsettled, contested or id-less verified rows.

acceptanceCohort.method: Immediately adjacent comparable short-form wakes from the same subscriber and loop routine; baseline wake 145 predates the compactor, candidate wake 147 follows runtime activation of the one-expanded-row tightening.

historicalBroadPopulation.scopeCaveat: This is the complete workspace loop-wake population for the two time windows, not a matched per-owner routine cohort. It remains historical context, but cannot establish causality for BYOC carry and is superseded for R-004 acceptance by the matched same-owner/routine comparison.

R-005.assertion: Every hit re-verified bytes, Ed25519 signature, manifest, offline payload and tenant identity. Source, gitlink, dependency, toolchain, profile, policy, signing and audit changes each invalidate reuse, and the exact expiry boundary refuses.

R-006.assertion: The canonical producer is active but has not yet completed the canary and literal soak. P-008's published-but-initialization-failed negative control remains valid, but no positive deployed completion is claimed here.
